title: Am i doing it right? I dont use Claude because i dont want to pay for it. I use Codex, and then use the browser Claude.
author: FutureLynx_
selftext:
I use Codex until i run out of free monthly credits that happens usually after like week or less.

The rest i just use chatgpt and claude in the browser, so its always free.

The rest i do it all manually. Am missing out a lot? What else can i do for free?

comments.author: Derreus
comments.body:
I would say you’re missing out. I’ve only used Gemini Pro, but the difference between its ‘Pro’ responses and its free responses are night and day.

I would suggest doing some research to figure out which pro model would work best for you. If this is just for fun to make some flash games, you might be alright to keep going like this.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: i would definitely try to use the 20€ cursor pack. thats not that much money but it can do magic with your code ... like full refractors, komplex shadows in isometrix 2d environments, debug in seconds, make git saves itself, run its own tests itself, analyse weak points or archtekture oversights, easiest localization of my life, complete UI overhauls in minutes, 3d and 2d animations that you only have to tweak, not create a single bone/hitboxy urself, etc. its a m a z i n g

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: thanks. yeah its great even in the browser. And codex is doing a lot of that too. You recommend cursor? Isnt Claude better?

replies.author: Livid_Shallot5701
replies.body:
claude is amazing but 1. you can also use some claude in cursor (as api you have an extra limit fore it) and 2. its more expensive. 

its better, but you can do way less.

so what is better, using a good ai intensively for a week or an insane ai for a day ... choice

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: Im using Codex. And its okay. It is free for some time. Do i really need Claude? It seems its doing okay. Though it runs out sometimes. Like a few days ago it ran out, and I had to use gpt and claude in the browser. There's also github copilot and cursor with some free use.

comments.author: hateborne
comments.body: Having to use Cursor at work and Claude at home, it feels like Claude iterates SO MUCH BETTER. Codex has a slight advantage for planning, but it just isn't impressive in the slightest. I burned through the $20/month quota in one afternoon writing a mouse replacement app for older games. 3.5 hours and it was dead for the month (unless I paid more)

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: The thing with claude is that you dont even get free use. Codex gives me free use for some time. Github copilot and Cursor also. Should i stick with these. Or claude is worth it?

comments.author: KhaosPT
comments.body: Using an harness vs just the chat is night and day. It can look at all the context on your game, re use skills, stuff like art it can look at your assets and generate something that matches. Allowing it to do edits it can just hook the stuff into the game, run the game and debug. On Claude I literally told it what I wanted on the tutorial in the microphone and it implemented the way I wanted it ( I did have to refactor pets of the code). Honestly 20 dollars for the amount of productivity it does is just good money. Imagine if you don't have to copy and paste and just let it do like a person would. That's exactly it, I let it do the stuff while o do something else and then I just look at the files it changed and review. I think Claude code is better at coding and testing, but that's just my opinion. Codex/chatgtp has the advantage of being good at graphics, the coding part is not as strong IMO but also does the job and I alternate between the 2 each month.

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: Im using Codex. And its okay. It is free for some time. Do i really need Claude? It seems its doing okay. Though it runs out sometimes. Like a few days ago it ran out, and I had to use gpt and claude in the browser. There's also github copilot and cursor with some free use.

replies.author: KhaosPT
replies.body: Just my perception but codex is okay on sol, it's great to generate art assets that are consistent. But Claude, even sonnet and opus, is just better at organizing and getting the job done. Going to the web browser after having it just on vs code where it can interact directly with the code and just let it do it's thing is where the value is at. What I do now is I'm testing the game, open the microphone chat and just start describing what I want changed as I go. I close it and Claude is already planning how to change the code. Then I just approve and go back testing again. You wouldn't get this speed on the browser, the productivity is just unreal.
